assertions.description: WebTransport constructor is exposed on the global scope.
WebTransport.prototype.draining is exposed to signal graceful session retirement.
Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(WebTransport.prototype, 'draining') exposes a getter function on the prototype.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport === 'undefined') return false; const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(WebTransport.prototype, 'draining'); return Boolean(desc && typeof desc.get === 'function' && desc.set === undefined); })()

assertions.description: WebTransport.prototype exposes the complete session lifecycle Promise getters (ready, draining, closed).
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport === 'undefined') return false; return ['ready', 'draining', 'closed'].every((prop) => typeof Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(WebTransport.prototype, prop)?.get === 'function'); })()

assertions.description: Receiving an HTTP/3 DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION capsule (0x78ae) on an active QUIC/HTTP/3 session resolves the draining Promise while keeping existing bidirectional and unidirectional streams open.
assertions.test: Requires a live HTTP/3 WebTransport server emitting a DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION capsule (0x78ae) over QUIC on the extended CONNECT stream.
